items.item: (1) In brief to the anchor, at its depth (H14, H15, H16a, H13)
items.how: After the condition: 'Read in time, it holds only from some step on, and there exactly where each one's acts, from every step, come to bear on every other's later continuation (07 §4.11)'. Then the anchor's definition, placed as the first screen now places it, so that 'there' cannot be read as the in-time reading (the ranking theorems take the condition read across all steps; no theorem composes the from-some-step-on form with self-concern, as the ch08 report found): 'A course widens another when it keeps all the other keeps and lets more form, more future; where the condition holds, read across all steps, whatever a widening adds lies within the life's own reach. Call a life's order over courses self-concerned when it ranks above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation, read as what lies within its reach: there, that order already ranks every widening above what it widens'. The proved parenthesis: 'on a finite listing and, with admission decided, between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, so that their admissions end; the course of a line that persists without end never fits such a list, so there this route is silent; the two results compose directly, though no single theorem states the composite'. 'Seeing them is needed for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough'. 'And', not 'so', before 'adds no premise' was already there. Chinese: the same, in the Chinese first screen's words as README-ZH.md stood at 04:12 (按时间来读，它只从某一步起才成立…; 扩大，就是更多的未来; 有一种次序，这里称为自我关切…自身的延续，这里读作自身所能到达的范围之内者; 在延续条件成立之处（跨越所有步来读）; 再把一个进程所容纳之物的权重加起来的计法; 要让选择因它们的损失而改变，就得看见它们，但看见还不够; 模型对持续存在所显示的，只是对已作选择的一道筛选; 一条没有尽头地延续下去的谱系…所以这条路径对它什么也没有说); 而 before 按扩大排序; 每一个延续 throughout; （只证明了这一方向） dropped, as the English no longer says 'one way'.

items.item: (2) H11: USES People-and-AI Conditional line and the handover
items.how: Opened Direction.lean:271 (`Requirement.Handover.direction` takes only `priority : Priority (tierFrame Handover.protection Handover.realization) basicSide gainSide better`, J1/J2 on the tier frame), FrontierFrames.lean:418 (`Priority`) and :445 (`Priority.comparison` gives `Comparison F living …` wherever it is decided whether an extension adds a basic claim, living being the frame's gain side), and Frontier.lean:520-560 (protections and realizations: transfer adds the successor gain, expansion has the capability gain and loses a protection). USES.md: 'conditional on the continuation condition, J1–J4 and a correspondence, comparing moves by widening' (zh 依于延续条件、J1–J4 与一个对应，以扩大比较诸举措). USES-EXAMPLES: italic line 'its verdicts conditional on the continuation condition, J1–J4 and a correspondence, plans compared by widening'; paragraph: 'The case's verdicts take J1/J2 (below), not C, as their hypothesis (`Requirement.Handover.direction` takes `Priority`), and under them transfer ranks above keep service and above expansion. An order meeting J1/J2 meets C (`Comparison`) wherever it is decided whether an extension adds a basic condition (`Priority.comparison`); here C asks that a plan rank above every plan it extends, keeping every basic condition and gain the other has and adding a gain' (H12: C said with the frame's living, the gains, not every claim); 'Neither widening nor C decides a mixed comparison'; 'The judgment's premises, J1–J4, were proposed by the AI' (no longer 'further premises', since the verdicts now name J1/J2 first). Chinese the same. The Human development Conditional line also names J1/J2 beside C: 'self-concern with the condition held de se, an order meeting C (`Comparison`), or the practical commitments J1/J2 (`Priority`)', since theorems taking `Comparison` exist (Alternatives, Lifting, Extension, RoutesToC, ScoreRepresentation) and the direction's take `Priority`.

In 04's current words: 'its evolutionary explanation, its evaluation as right or wrong (which forms within becoming, in those who judge it, not in its explanation), its recognition and its actual preservation kept apart'; zh '其中这一倾向的演化解释、对它的是非评价（这一评价在生灭变化之中、在评判它的人之中形成，不在它的解释之中）、对它的承认与它实际的保存彼此分开'.

items.how: Home checked: experiments/direction-installation/README.md:57 'No condition kept a dependent no member was told of', :50 'With the bed not told, talk among the fishers keeps nothing (0 of 10)'. 'What the laws say': 'untold, the bed lay beyond what the fishers' selection read, and in the test no instruction tried preserved it' (was 'under every instruction tried it was lost'); 'Whether the loss counts': 'Seeing the bed is needed there for a choice to answer to its loss, and not enough'. items.item: (5) The valley's 'so on such a listing'; the checklist and valley by H14 and H19
items.how: Valley: 'A widens B, so, on a finite listing of what the valley's courses admit, every additive weighting … ranks A above B; and where the condition holds de se, an order a life may hold that ranks above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation, read as what lies within its reach (self-concern), ranks every widening on that listing above what it widens'. Checklist: 'and comparing by widening adds no premise beside a life's own concern: where the condition holds de se, a self-concerned order, one ranking above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation, read as what lies within its reach, already ranks every widening above what it widens on a finite listing (07 §4); that a life forms such an order is not shown (07 §4.9)' (was 'an order holding one's own continuation, if a life holds one, … so comparing by widening adds no premise', which the ch08 report listed). Each example defines self-concern itself, since examples are read one at a time. Chinese the same (所以在这样的列表上 gone; 而以扩大来比较).
